cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Look for supabase compose
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("find /opt -name 'docker-compose*.yml' 2>/dev/null | xargs ls -la 2>/dev/null")
print("Files:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
